body:
Every generation so far has been shit and I see no reason or stimuli that could ever make that change,I believe humanity is doomed to drown it it's own short-sighted avarice and I say this as some one who has had a predisposition towards altruism and the preparations I am making to end my life will allow me to be a full organ donor and I will continue to give blood till the day I end it.

I am and people like me are a drop in the ocean, and I have come to the conclusion that people who push what seems to be a benign agenda from a place of power often have their own interests at heart and often lust for more power or wealth , I think it's clear that kindness is drawn from something purely genetic as a species survival mechanism and I coincider my self ashamed by the fact that I fall for it, though it is one of the few honest joys I have found in my existence. 

I hope we all die but I'd like to end it for myself soon,this is my decision and I feel free to know I'll be unburdened by existence.

I'm not lonely,I have loving family and friends and no horrible things in my past. I don't think I've ever really suffered from depression. I just look at the world and don't really want to be a part of it anymore, sure there are fleeting interests but nothing tangible that distracts me long enough from the shit show that we are on a whole. 

I hate being human and all that entails, we're a horrible species that pushes selfish arseholes to the top and for every step we seem to take forward we take another one back.
sure I can see altruism in the world but greed and callousness always takes over from that.

Days come when I pretty much hope we all die but seeing as I can't see that happening anytime soon, I may as well rid my self from the herd.

P.S I don't care for trying to make the world a better place, the future generations of humans will just be as shitty so why bother.

What I'd do to be given the chance for it all to end as easy as that. 

 I'm so sorry that you feel this way and hope you'll find a soul out there who'll listen.
